review: Visually checked against page 1 of the original FFC PDFs on 2026-10-22. Reported times are PKT (UTC+05:00). These are sparse snapshots, not continuous telemetry.
exclusions: Swat observations at Khwazakhela, Chakdara and Munda are nested upstream of Khiali/Charsadda Road. Do not add them as independent inflows or substitute them for that gauge.
Peak values without an explicit observation date and time are not hydrograph ordinates.
Nowshera is the evaluation gauge; its narrative observations are not inflow or lateral inputs.
PDMA daily weather report river tables publish a date but no observation time. Preserve them as untimed reference data, not hourly boundary observations.
